content_units: Toronto to Lisbon Value Snapshot

For your dates and priorities, the best value is   TAP Air Portugal  : it stays within your   CAD 1,100   budget, is   nonstop  , includes your   carry-on  , and adds useful flexibility for a modest change fee. If pure lowest hassle matters most, the nonstop options clearly beat Lufthansa’s cheaper fare with a layover.
Ranked Flight Comparison
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
TAP Air Portugal   10:45 PM   10:40 AM   6h 55m   Non-stop   CAD 915
Air Transat   09:30 PM   09:40 AM   7h 10m   Non-stop   CAD 842
Air Canada   11:20 PM   11:20 AM   7h 00m   Non-stop   CAD 1,084
Lufthansa   05:15 PM   09:55 AM   11h 40m   1 stop   CAD 768
1) TAP Air Portugal — Best overall value
- Best balance of   price, convenience, and flexibility  .
- It is the   fastest itinerary   and   nonstop  , which matches your strong preference for fewer layovers.
- The extra   CAD 73   over Air Transat buys better trip protection with   one date change for CAD 120  .
- For a solo traveler, that flexibility is meaningful without pushing you near budget limits.
View TAP
2) Air Transat — Best budget nonstop
- Best choice if your top goal is   lowest price among nonstop flights  .
- At   CAD 842  , it leaves the most room in budget for seat selection, transit, or trip expenses.
- Main tradeoff:   nonrefundable  , so it is less forgiving if your plans change.
View Air Transat
3) Air Canada — Flexible-ish but overpriced for the value
- Still within budget and   nonstop  , so operationally it fits your priorities.
- But at   CAD 1,084  , it is only   CAD 16   under your cap and costs   CAD 169 more than TAP  .
- The refund option is weaker than it first sounds because it still carries a   CAD 180 fee  .
- Good only if you strongly prefer Air Canada service or loyalty benefits.
View Air Canada
4) Lufthansa — Cheapest, but weakest fit for your priorities
- Lowest fare at   CAD 768  , but the   1 stop in Frankfurt   sharply reduces convenience.
- Total travel time jumps to   11h 40m  , around   4h 45m longer than TAP  .
- Refund policy is also less useful:   voucher only  .
- Best only if you want to minimize airfare and are willing to accept the layover.
View Lufthansa
Best Pick for Your Travel Style
Recommended: TAP Air Portugal
Why it wins for you, in order of your priorities:
-   Fewer layovers:   nonstop
-   Carry-on only:   included
-   Budget under CAD 1,100:   yes
-   Overall value:   stronger flexibility than Air Transat for a relatively small price increase
Tradeoff in one line
-   Choose TAP   if you want the smartest overall buy.
-   Choose Air Transat   if saving   CAD 73   matters more than change flexibility.
-   Choose Air Canada   only if airline preference or points matter.
-   Choose Lufthansa   only if lowest fare outweighs your dislike of layovers.
